paths.title: Academy Master
paths.description: Master the fundamentals of arcane magic until even your simplest spells set up stronger follow-up attacks and strike with greater force. Your schooling sharpens your Arcana knowledge, while an action point gives you a chance to correct a missed attack. You can pour extra power into familiar spells, reclaim an encounter attack that misses every target, and eventually turn a practiced encounter spell into a more punishing assault with longer-lasting effects.

paths.title: Arcane Wayfarer
paths.description: Step through space as easily as another wizard crosses a room, eventually gaining teleportation as a normal way to move. Critical hits let you teleport your victims, and an action point carries you to a better position before the fight can pin you down. Your spells send allies to safety and enemies into danger, whisk you away from an incoming attack, and finally strand a group of creatures in an interplanar space until they find their way back.

paths.title: Blood Mage
paths.description: Pay for greater spell damage with your own blood, turning self-inflicted wounds into power behind your most demanding attacks. An action point attack leaves its victims bleeding, while your second wind can set already-afflicted enemies alight. Your spells punish foes for moving and leave crowds dazed beneath lingering psychic pain, and you can sacrifice a healing surge to recover a spent encounter power when the battle demands more magic.

paths.title: Bonded Summoner
paths.description: Build a lasting bond with your summoned creatures, keeping them in the fight with healing and, eventually, regeneration. An action point lets you command each of your summons, while conjuration and summoning spells carry you a short teleport out of danger. A planar gateway scatters creatures that stray too close, and your greatest servant is a towering protector that dazes crowds, knocks attackers down, and can trade places with you in an instant.

paths.title: Master of Flame
paths.description: Give yourself completely to fire, spreading burning wounds and eventually widening every arcane fire burst and blast you cast. Critical hits kindle lingering flames, and an action point scorches enemies gathered beside you. You can fan an existing blaze into a second explosion, become an insubstantial creature of fire whose touch punishes melee attackers, and raise a hungry inferno that drags nearby creatures toward its center.

paths.title: Planeshifter
paths.description: Treat distance and planar boundaries as problems you already know how to solve, gaining portal lore and a long teleport alongside your action point maneuver. In battle, you can banish an enemy long enough to change the odds, and later your presence keeps nearby allies from being teleported against their will. Your portals offer a swift escape to a known circle at a steep cost in healing surges, while your greatest attack sends a foe through a succession of hostile planes and brings it back still suffering.

paths.title: Rimetongue Caller
paths.description: Speak winter into your summons, granting yourself and your servants resistance to cold before surrounding them with a frostbite aura that harms any creature lingering nearby. An action point chills and slows adjacent enemies, while your spells raise an obscuring wall of ice and wind or infuse a fresh summon with cold immunity and harder-hitting attacks. Your greatest calling brings forth a rimefire brute that knocks foes down, freezes groups in place, and spreads its killing cold farther across the battlefield.

paths.title: Spellstorm Mage
paths.description: Draw spells from the arcane storm around you, using Wisdom to determine how powerful a spent spell you can reclaim each day. An action point strengthens your attacks for the turn, and becoming bloodied eventually answers your enemies with a burst of lightning. Your magic cages creatures behind a crackling wall, sweeps a moving curtain of rain across the battlefield, and scatters enemies through a maelstrom of force and teleportation.

paths.title: War Wizard of Cormyr
paths.description: Train for the battlefield, turning a chosen single-target wizard spell into a basic attack that fits naturally into your companions' tactics. Your action point attacks let you cast ranged and area spells without provoking opportunity attacks, while critical hits with close and area attacks eventually punish every target more severely. Sweeping lightning prepares your next strike, a selective barrier shields you from distant attacks while letting your spells through, and a thunderous assault leaves its targets open to your allies.
